item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
President Murmu addressed the Bastar Dussehra festival in Chhattisgarh, indicating a shift from Maoist violence toward development. The Kuki-Zo Women’s forum called for President's Rule in Manipur, describing the crisis as political rather than security related. Bastar is reported to be leaving the Maoist shadow and stepping into growth. IndiGo extended flight cancellations to Saudi Arabia because of security concerns. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
